mathematical_sources.note: The selected weighted-support, displacement and divisor-cover theorems are proved in the Lean modules of this repository and explained in the two immutable paper sources below. The earlier reciprocal-summable assertion is credited to Erdős. No novelty priority or resolution of the unrestricted parent problem is asserted by this metadata.

mathematical_sources.title: Reciprocal Mersenne Subseries — complete reasoning record

mathematical_sources.note: Math. Student 36 (1968), 222–226 (issued 1969), especially p. 222. Erdős stated the reciprocal-summable all-integer-base criterion after proving the coprime case and discussed possible weakenings. That prior statement is credited; the selected weighted and cover criteria are not presented as a new discovery of the reciprocal-summable case.
